name: Abby Ewing
tagline: Top rated Family Law attorney in Dallas, Texas
education: Arizona State University Sandra Day O'Connor College of Law
about: Abby has built a practice representing people from all walks of life, from single mothers to CEOs and entrepreneurs during some of the most difficult times in their lives. She brings a distinct ability to understand and relate to people at the most fundamental level when representing her clients, both inside and outside of the courtroom.

Abby has experience in complex property division and divorce cases, as well as pre- and post- marital agreements, collaborative divorce, and child support and custody matters including those involving the UCCJEA and 1980 Hague Convention on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction. Abby’s background as a commercial litigator serves as a benefit to her clients and while she always strives to resolve matters in the most amicable and efficient manner, she is a skilled advocate in court who gets straight to critical issues and gets results effectively. The breadth of her legal experience, coupled with her dedication to her clients, results in her clients receiving legal representation that helps them secure the outcomes that move their lives and their goals forward.

Abby was named one of the Best Lawyers in Dallas by D Magazine. She has also been included among The Best Lawyers in America and the list of Texas Super Lawyers published by Texas Monthly Magazine (Thomson Reuters). Before reaching the age of 40, Abby was included six times on the Texas Rising Stars list, also published by Texas Monthly Magazine (Thomson Reuters).
